LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 15.1.1 ORAL REPORTS: EVENTS WITHIN THE CLASSROOM

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.1: Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports: Events within the Classroom
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports: Events within the Classroom, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you make an oral report presentation interesting? 2. Why is it important to practise oral report presentation?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports: Events within the Classroom together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: A learner practises their digital knowledge by searching online for report preparation and

presentation skills.

● Critical thinking and problem solving: A learner makes objective observations when evaluating the strengths and

weaknesses of their peers’ oral reports.

Values:
Patriotism: A learner addresses class issues in their reports.

Link to other subjects:

● All language subjects emphasise oral skills

● Computer Science, Agriculture, Home Science, and Integrated Science require reporting skills for projects

Suggested Learning Resources

Braille/flash cards, digital devices with assistive technology, audio recording
